jsesh.hieroglyphs
Class DirectoryHieroglyphicFontManager

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.hieroglyphs.DirectoryHieroglyphicFontManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
HieroglyphicFontManager
public class DirectoryHieroglyphicFontManager
extends java.lang.Object
implements HieroglyphicFontManager

A font manager which stores the signs as files in a directory. The codes for the signs are simply the names of the files ; for instance, "A320.svg" would contain the code for the sign "A320". Note that, as files systems are not always case-sensitive, "a320.svg" would do just the same, and "aa320.svg" would be a correct file name for the sign "Aa320".

rosmord
